_experiment: observed-graph detector calibration on a dedicated null

design.selection_rule: independently for each named observable, smallest k on the existing quarter-step grid with null FPR at or below 3.5%; no selection between observables

obs_giant_frac._declared: CALIBRATED 2026-09-03 on 600 dedicated control runs, seed block 960000-960599, disjoint from earlier calibration blocks and every scored seed below 900000. Configuration c=1.0, white/mid, MNAR, identical to the existing recalibration. The observable is obs_giant_frac. All other leading-rule fields are copied unchanged from detection_rule_recal.json. Selection is the same declared procedure: the smallest k on the 2.00 to 16.00 quarter-step grid with calibration-null FPR at or below 3.5%. The rule is applied unchanged at every coverage, error colour, severity, consent arm, and scenario.

leading.class_mixing: mean of per-class standardised statistic (variance-family only; no covariance across node pairs)
leading.standardisation: z against the same run's baseline period [window-1, 90)

lagging.metric: program-close output, trailing mean over 10 cycles
